text:
Totally fair, that was a lot of theory in one sitting. One quick fix before you go: in version 1, I labeled the chord **C₃ – E₃ – A₃** as "C/E," but those notes actually make **Am in first inversion (Am/C)**. A true C/E would be **E₃ – G₃ – C₄**. Either works in that spot; Am/C just keeps you on the tonic chord.

Everything else should hold up when you try it at the piano. Get some rest!
